title: Allowed Amount Rates for Paper Claims, Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Rate rule.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the network rate per day of a paper claim is the allowed amount of the member's most recent paid network claim for the same drug divided by that claim's days supply, or, when the member has no paid network claim for the drug, the amount on the receipt divided by the receipt's days supply. The allowed amount of the paper claim depends on where the fill was bought:

| Where the fill was bought | Allowed amount of the paper claim |
|---|---|
| Outside the United States (no United States network price exists) | The amount on the receipt multiplied by the reimbursed days, divided by the receipt's days supply and multiplied by the network's out-of-network rate, rounded to the cent |
| Out-of-network pharmacy in the United States | The network rate per day multiplied by the reimbursed days and by the network's out-of-network rate, rounded to the cent |
| Network pharmacy | The network rate per day multiplied by the reimbursed days, rounded to the cent |

The reimbursed days are those on which the paper claim is finally priced. The rate per day is not rounded; the allowed amount is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Out-of-network rate by network

| Network | Out-of-network rate (fraction of the network allowed amount) |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Performance Network | 1.0 |
| Northbridge Essential Network | 1.0 |
| Northbridge National Network | 1.0 |
| Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | 1.0 |
| Northbridge Retail90 Network | 1.0 |
| Northbridge Open Choice Network | 0.8 (80 percent) |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- **Network pharmacy.** Most recent paid network claim: allowed amount 100.00 USD for 30 days, so 3.333... USD per day, unrounded. Reimbursed days 20: 3.333... multiplied by 20 is 66.666..., rounded to 66.67 USD.
- **Out-of-network pharmacy in the United States, Northbridge Open Choice Network.** Rate per day 4.00 USD, reimbursed days 30: 4.00 multiplied by 30 and by 0.8 is 96.00 USD.
- **Bought abroad, Northbridge Retail90 Network.** Receipt: 150.00 USD for 45 days; reimbursed days 30: 150.00 multiplied by 30, divided by 45 and multiplied by 1.0 is 100.00 USD. No network claim enters this figure.
- **No paid network claim, network pharmacy.** Receipt: 84.00 USD for 28 days gives 3.00 USD per day; reimbursed days 28 give 84.00 USD.
